unread_meter_label: Meter could not be read this cycle
breakdown_empty: Enter a consumption reading to see the breakdown.
slices_notice: Min kWh is derived automatically from the previous slice's max, so every slice stays contiguous. Edit a slice's Max to resize both it and the slice above it. The last slice is always open-ended. Billing mode controls whether this slice charges only its own kWh (Progressive) or the entire consumption at its rate once reached (Flat) — matching how Egypt bills slice 7 today.
transition_notice: Extra deductions applied the moment a reading crosses into a slice — the "abu kart" prepaid-meter surcharge pattern. Off by default; only relevant for prepaid billing.
fees_notice: Any additional charges beyond the slice rate and service fee — fixed amounts, a percentage of the energy charge, or a per-kWh add-on. Applied automatically to every calculation while active.
error_invalid_consumption: Enter a valid, non-negative consumption in kWh.
error_billing_month_required: Pick a billing month to save this bill.
min_one_slice: A tariff needs at least one slice.
